title: A new release that boots only with one environment's settings: after the rollout every production pod fails to start
question: self 클러스터 shop-20에서 shop-web이 전부 안 열린대. 원인이 뭐야?
question_vague: self 클러스터 shop-20 사이트가 다운됐다는 말이 있어. 원인 찾아줘.
wait: kubectl -n $NS wait --for=condition=Available deploy/shop-web deploy/preview-web deploy/assets deploy/visitor --timeout=10s
inject_wait: kubectl -n $NS logs deploy/visitor --since=20s | grep 'page failed' | grep -q 'site=shop '
